# M-006 — Living Engineering OS Release 2

**Status:** Planned  
**Target gate:** 2027-02-14 (forecast)  
**Increment:** PI-EXP-003  
**Product Goal:** PG-004
sections.title: M-006 — Living Engineering OS Release 2

sections.text:
## Outcome

Monad can operate across local, air-gapped, on-premises, and optional cloud profiles; clone/restore governed workspace state; reproduce environments; manage governed files/media; integrate through MCP/LSP/plugins/storage adapters; isolate optional external-runtime profiles; execute independent internal work deterministically in parallel; and meet declared scale/finalization benchmarks with complete security/provenance evidence.
sections.title: Outcome
Acceptance
